snippets.SINTEPAN_EXPORT_MSG: You can find the song in the clipboard. Now paste it in a blog, email or text file.
snippets.SINTEPAN_HELP_LOAD: To listen to a song that was created previously, you must have its song-code and paste it into the box below. If you don't have a song-code you must create a song first or get your friends to send you their songs! Once you have pasted your song here click on "Play".
snippets.SINTEPAN_HELP_SAVE: The text below shows you the song-code for the song you have made so far. You can copy and paste it to a file so that you can listen to it later. Or you can email it to a friend!! This way you can share your songs with others. To listen to a song for which you have the song-code, click on the "Load song" button
snippets.SINTEPAN_RESET_MSG: Are you sure you want to erase all notes and start again?
